claims.statement: A selected committed opportunity and its declared prerequisite routes accompany a concrete actual intervention rehearsal, with explicit matches to the verified patch paths and separate candidate knowledge.

attributes.title: Possibility-directed intervention rehearsal

alignment.basis: Supports purposeful long-horizon development and compounding product knowledge under ADR 0038.

ambition.basis: Connects a selected prospective future to concrete construction evidence without automatic selection.

horizon.basis: Reuses existing ecology, exact source access and disposable patch rehearsal.

realization.basis: Candidate source authored; live use pending.

disposition_history.authority: agent construction selection within delegated self-development
disposition_history.rationale: Select possibility-directed real intervention context over manual joining or automated readiness/synthesis.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Compose an explicit selected BASE opportunity's existing possibility ecology and required-capability routes with actual patch path names, exact committed tree status and the existing disposable patch review; use the same BASE index and separate candidate preflight.
attributes.value_hypothesis: A development agent can relate a concrete proposed intervention to a selected future and its authored prerequisite context without manually joining separate queries or treating candidate evidence as BASE intent.
attributes.revisit_when: Actual interventions need more than direct prerequisite routes or file:src/sensemaking_skills/patch_rehearsal.py changes.
attributes.counterevidence: Manual queries and source review remain viable. Authored prerequisites and citations need not be necessary or sufficient; ownership is a declared relationship. The dedicated source-access module supports coherent reuse but is not a necessary causal prerequisite.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Source-authored candidate; actual use, comparative cost and independent cognitive benefit not established.

value_frame.beneficiary: Development agent translating a selected valuable future into a concrete intervention.
value_frame.criterion: Actual co-design patch reports exact BASE opportunity, prerequisite and owned-path versus citation matches, preserves absent new files and default rehearsal evidence, refuses missing/goal focus.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Separate exact-BASE possibility-ecology and patch-rehearsal with manually joined source names.
value_frame.expected_observation: Two cited prerequisite capabilities on actual patch_rehearsal.py; separate explicit component ownership on a real historical source patch; new candidate files absent at BASE, unchanged default result after removing opt-in context.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: Reconsider if a candidate record enters BASE, evidence and ownership are conflated, source status disagrees with the actual patch, the default contract changes, or a later agent finds manual composition preferable.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: One optional flag and bounded composition in existing disposable index; no new ontology or inferential controller.
